    {"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":78,"why":"Doctor advised 'you can up the dose. If you're using just three puffs twice a day, you can increase it to four puffs twice a day.' and 'while you're at home, we're going to by increasing your Clenil, we are increasing your steroid intake anyway.'"},
    {"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":70,"why":"Doctor said 'So what we need to do that obviously we you haven't had an asthma check for sometime and it looks like you can be having a small, small exacerbation. So what, I would like you to be seen by one of our GP's in the next few days.'"},
